steps.title: Prepare qRT-PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Use the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088) to set up the Measles Vaccine Virus Taqman-MGB assay.

steps.title: Run Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Perform the PCR cycling according to the following conditions:

substeps.instruction: Cycle 40 times: 95°C for 3 seconds, then 60°C for 30 seconds

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following criteria for a satisfactory positive result:

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Ensure fluorescence intensity is suitable compared to a positive control.
Confirm a defined threshold (CT) value has been exceeded in the log-linear phase.
Classify results as negative if the CT value is 40 cycles or greater.
Confirm that No Template Controls (NTCs) do not produce a curve.
